summary: Iteration_20 verified the new POST /api/contracts/{id}/mark-complete-multi endpoint AND the frontend routing that hits it for multi-join / multi-crew contracts. Backend pytest suite (4 cases) all PASS: (1) poster completes a multi-join LFG -> 200 status='completed' and server-side GET confirms status='completed'; (2) idempotent second call -> 200 with message 'Contract already finalised' and status='completed'; (3) same endpoint on a single-slot contract -> 400; (4) non-poster (admin) calling on demo's multi-join -> 403. Poster contracts_completed and each distinct participant's contracts_completed each increment by 1 (verified via /auth/me before/after). Frontend spot-check (preview URL, demo user + admin acceptor): the demo poster's 'Mark Complete' click on a multi-join LFG (a) fires POST /api/contracts/{id}/mark-complete-multi (network request captured), (b) opens data-testid='multi-rating-modal' ('Rate Your Crew' with Mowri row + 5-star input + 'Finish Later'), and (c) after the call the contract moves to '// PENDING_RATINGS' with 'COMPLETED' badge — its server-side status is 'completed' (verified via GET /api/contracts/{id}). Single-slot regression: code inspection of Contracts.jsx handleMarkComplete (L539-555) confirms isMulti = (contract.join_mode==='multi' || contract.is_multi_crew), and endpoint = isMulti ? 'mark-complete-multi' : 'mark-complete' — single-slot still routes to /mark-complete and setShowReview({role:'both'}) still triggers when response.data.show_rating is set and _openMultiRatingIfNeeded returns false.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint implementation (server.py L4426-L4464) is clean: guards auth (401), existence (404), poster (403), multi-only (400), idempotency (early-return 200 for terminal states). Increments contracts_completed for poster + de-duped participants across accepted_participants and manifest.accepted_by. Fires cleanup + history dispatch as background tasks. Good.

Minor: response body on success returns show_rating:true but frontend actually uses _openMultiRatingIfNeeded first (which succeeds for multi), so show_rating is effectively ignored on the multi path. Not a bug, just dead-ish signal in success payload.
Carry-over: server.py still ~5134 lines; consider router split when convenient.
